Rotate: left-drag. Zoom: scroll. Pan: right-drag. Hover for coordinates.

Global PCA projects all trajectory points into the space of maximum variance.

Switch k with the dropdown — watch centroids rearrange as granularity changes.

The sequence of cluster letters is what the edit-distance algorithm compares.

Top row: intra-class (same gesture, two subjects). Bottom: inter-class. Good DTW: intra-distance < inter-distance.

After preprocessing, gestures of the same class overlap closely — easier to match by path distance.

Each coloured segment = one 'letter' in the symbolic string. Right side shows the compressed version.

Black = test gesture. Dashed = nearest neighbours. Each method may pick different neighbours.

Row = true class. Column = predicted class. Diagonal = correct. Off-diagonal = confusion.

User-dependent is easier: training and test data share the same user. The gap shows how much gesture style varies between users.
